name: Image questions
description: Let the agent answer questions about attached screenshots and images when the current chat model cannot see them.

settingsComponent.label: Image questions
settingsComponent.description: Choose the vision model Neon Pilot uses to answer questions about attached images and screenshots. You only need this if image analysis gives poor answers or uses the wrong model.

tools.name: probe_image
